result.summary: Found 2 issues: the middle card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is vertically misaligned, and the favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards are styled inconsistently.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Smash Bros Burgers card sits about 28px lower than its neighbors. Its image starts around y=659, while the Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria cards start around y=631. As a result, its title and delivery fee also sit lower than the other cards' labels, breaking the row's shared baseline.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel items to the top (e.g., align-items: flex-start) and remove any extra margin or padding on the second card so every image, badge, and title shares the same vertical position.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between cards. The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a bare white heart icon, while the pizza card below shows the heart inside a dark translucent circle.
issues.suggestion: Use a single favorite-button style for all restaurant cards, ideally the circular backdrop, which keeps the icon legible over any image.
